en: Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor of the sense-sphere, a neutral state of the sense-sphere arises by way of root condition.

(Abbreviated. Under root condition there are five; under predominance condition there are five ... [etc. ... under mutuality condition there are three ... [etc. ... under resultant condition there are three ... [etc. ... under non-disappearance condition there are five.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor not of the sense-sphere, a neutral state that is not of the sense-sphere arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three ... [etc. ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
